Position.description:
A point in the venue's local metric frame, in metres.

Never latitude/longitude. Lat/lon exists only at the circuit pack's origin and at the device's location adapter (plan.md section 10).

RadioObservation.description: One radio heard once. Never leaves the handset except in an operator survey.

frequency_mhz.description: 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz attenuate differently; the solver uses it to pick the exponent when the anchor does not supply one

rssi_dbm.description: received signal strength, dBm. Negative; closer to zero is stronger.

SurveyReport.description:
An operator walk test: observations WITH their positions, to build an anchor map.

The one path where raw radio observations legitimately leave a device, and it is a staff device on a surveying job, not a spectator's phone. Separate contract, separate endpoint, separate consent — so that no amount of refactoring can quietly widen the spectator path into this one.

surveyor.description: who walked it; a staff identifier, not a pseudonym

accuracy_m.description: how well the surveyor knew where they were standing

position.description: ground truth for this sample, venue frame
